Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the mechanical engineering field. At Amazon we do highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

As a mechanical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
Who We Are:Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.
 
How You Will Make an Impact:
The Senior Automation Engineer leads the technical design and development of industrial automation applications at Atlas, combining hands-on development with technical leadership. This role builds complex automation solutions on Ignition and Allen-Bradley ControlLogix platforms while defining and enforcing development standards, application architecture, and engineering best practices. The Senior Automation Engineer also serves as a technical mentor to the automation team, guiding how solutions are designed, developed, and maintained while actively contributing to project delivery.
 
Responsibilities
Solution Development & Delivery

Design, develop, and deploy automation solutions using Ignition and Allen-Bradley ControlLogix platforms.
Lead the technical implementation of automation projects from design through commissioning.
Troubleshoot complex automation, controls, and SCADA issues across on-premises and cloud environments.

Architecture & Standards

Design application architectures and integration patterns between PLCs, SCADA systems, databases, APIs, and business systems.
Define and maintain standards for PLC programming, Ignition development, documentation, and system integration.
Establish reusable templates, libraries, and development frameworks that accelerate delivery and improve consistency.
Review designs and code to ensure quality, consistency, and maintainability.

Technical Leadership & Vendor Oversight

Mentor Automation Engineers and provide technical guidance during project execution.
Provide technical oversight of third-party automation vendors, including review of deliverables, issue resolution, project coordination, and confirmation that solutions align with Atlas engineering standards and architecture.
Maintain accurate technical documentation for automation systems, standards, and architectures.
Comply with all Atlas Energy Solutions safety policies, procedures, and site requirements when working in plant and field environments.
Other duties as assigned.

 
 Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Directly related experience may substitute for education
4+ years of experience with industrial automation systems
Experience with Allen-Bradley ControlLogix and Studio 5000
Experience developing applications in Ignition Perspective and/or Vision
Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, OPC UA, Modbus TCP, and MQTT
Experience integrating automation systems with databases, APIs, and enterprise applications
Experience working with both on-premises and cloud environments for VM hosts and third-party applications
Proven ability to lead technical projects and mentor other engineers
Experience providing technical oversight of third-party automation vendors, including deliverable review, issue resolution, and alignment to engineering standards
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills
Willingness and ability to work flexible hours and to be on-call after hours
Willingness to work at multiple geographic locations within Texas, including travel to Kermit, Monahans, and other locations
Valid Driver’s License and qualified through our company insurance/Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Policy

Preferred:

Ignition or Allen-Bradley certifications
Strong software development experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar programming languages, including object-oriented programming principles, source control (Git), code review practices, and modern software development workflows
Experience developing scripts, tools, and automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and streamline administrative processes across Windows and Linux environments
Familiarity with industrial automation and networking technologies, including LAN/WAN infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and distributed control platforms such as Opto 22 groov EPIC, CODESYS, edge computing devices, and remote operations systems
Experience with industrial data platforms, historians, and reporting systems such as OSI PI, Canary, SQL-based solutions, and cloud-connected analytics platforms
Experience in mining, manufacturing, energy, or similarly demanding industrial operations

 
Reporting Relationship:

Reports To: Process Engineer Manager
Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility but may provide mentorship, guidance, training, or work direction to others

 
Work Location & Travel Requirements

Location: Austin, TX
Work Environment: Office, Field, and Plant; industrial plant environments with exposure to operating equipment and limited climate control during site work
Travel %: 15%

 
 
Schedule/Work Arrangement: Monday–Friday, with flexible hours and after-hours on-call support as required; travel to multiple Texas locations, including Kermit and Monahans
 
Physical Demands:

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Regular use of hands to handle, finger, and reach equipment, tools, and controls
Required to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb stairs and ladders when working in plant and field environments
Must be able to work in and around operating and energized equipment while wearing required personal protective equipment
Must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and heavier items with appropriate assistance
Required vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
Must be able to travel by vehicle to project and operating sites within Texas
Must be able to tolerate conditions associated with plant and outdoor environments, including heat, cold, dust, noise, and limited climate control

 
 
How You Will Stand Out

You write code and standards that the next engineer can pick up without calling you.
You think in architecture, and you can see where an integration will break before it is built.
You mentor deliberately, and the engineers around you get measurably better.
You hold vendors to your standards and review their deliverables like you would your own.
You are a methodical troubleshooter who works from data and logs rather than guesswork.
You document thoroughly, because an undocumented system is a future outage.
You are team-oriented and approachable, and you work well with Operations, IT, and Engineering alike.

 
What You Will Love About Us

Best People and Team. Great Place to Work , Hire Vets, Top Place to Work For – Austin American Statesman
Your Well-Being is a Priority. 100% covered Medical, Dental, and Vision
Invest in Your Future. 401K with company match, immediate vesting
Relax and Recharge. Paid time off (non-rotational roles), 15+ company paid holidays

 
Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:Atlas Energy Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.
 
Reasonable AccommodationAtlas Energy Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and those with pregnancy-related conditions in accordance with applicable law.
 
Job DisclaimerThis job description is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified at any time based on business needs.

title: Drainage & Water Resources Engineer (Public Works)
location: 101 W Louis Henna Blvd, Suite 400, Austin, Texas 78728; 1701 Directors Blvd., Suite 1000, Austin, Texas 78744; 617 W. Fairwinds Street, Hallettsville, Texas 77964; 7330 San Pedro Ave., Suite 301, San Antonio, Texas 78216
description:
Your future begins here! BGE, Inc. is a nationwide civil engineering consulting firm offering diverse career opportunities in a wide range of disciplines for public and private infrastructure projects. Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes outstanding health care, generous 401(k) match, professional career resources, and highly competitive work-life balance programs, including personal-time allowances, dependent care, and flexible Fridays.
In addition, BGE provides unlimited sick leave, floating holidays, and robust career growth guidance, including organization-wide leadership and mentorship programs to help you build connections and shape your career. BGE goes beyond competitive benefits to attract and retain the best in an environment that inspires excellence.
 
 Location: This position can be based in any of the following BGE Texas locations: South Austin,  North Austin (Round Rock), San Antonio, Halletsville.
 
Responsibilities:

Prepare and review drainage design plans, hydrologic and hydraulic calculations, drainage reports, and technical memoranda for public infrastructure projects, including roadway improvements, municipal street reconstruction, storm sewer systems, channel improvements, detention facilities, and flood mitigation projects.
Develop stormwater management solutions in compliance with municipal, county, and regulatory agency requirements, ensuring designs are practical, cost-effective, and constructible.
Perform hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, storm sewer sizing, inlet evaluations, culvert design, detention pond analysis, drainage modeling, quantity takeoffs, and construction cost estimates for public works projects.
Utilize industry-standard drainage modeling and design software, including OpenRoads Designer Drainage Utility (ORD-DU), to analyze drainage systems, evaluate flood risk, and develop drainage infrastructure improvements.
Coordinate with roadway, water, wastewater, structural, survey, environmental, and planning teams to integrate drainage solutions into overall project designs.
Assist in preparing project deliverables for municipal clients, including drainage studies, engineering reports, permit applications, design plans, specifications, and agency submittals.
Participate in client meetings, project coordination meetings, and agency reviews with municipalities, counties, drainage districts, and other stakeholders.
Provide technical support during design development, quality assurance reviews, construction administration activities, and responses to contractor Requests for Information (RFIs).
Mentor junior engineering staff and assist with technical development, project delivery, and quality control efforts.

Requirements:

Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from an accredited university.
Professional Engineer (PE) license required, or ability to obtain Texas PE reciprocity within six months of hire.
Minimum of 5 years of drainage engineering experience supporting municipal, county, or public works infrastructure projects.
Experience designing storm sewer systems, detention facilities, open channels, culverts, and roadway drainage improvements.
Proficiency with OpenRoads Designer Drainage Utility (ORD-DU) preferred.
Working knowledge of MicroStation, OpenRoads Designer (ORD), Civil 3D, and/or AutoCAD.
Familiarity with municipal drainage criteria manuals, floodplain regulations, and stormwater management requirements.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare technical reports and interact effectively with clients and project teams.
Proposal preparation, business development, and client management experience is a plus.
Some of our Benefits:

401k Match: 100% up to 4% of your contributions with immediate vesting + 3% Safe Harbor Contribution with immediate vesting
Merit-Based Bonus Compensation
Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; BGE contributes to HSA on eligible plans
9 paid Holidays, including 3 Floating holidays
Personal Time Allowances 
2 to 4 weeks of Vacation, depending on experience-level. Unused vacation carries over to the next year.
"Unlimited" Sick Days.
Mentorship Program – Provides you with the opportunity to learn and receive guidance from seasoned professionals.
Employee Referral Program that pays you for bringing great people into the BGE family

BGE is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We prohibit discrimination and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, Vietnam Era Veteran Status, Disabled Veteran Status, or any other classification protected by federal, state or local laws.
NO SPONSORSHIPNO AGENCIES

description_html:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role

Crusoe is seeking a motivated Construction Project Specialist to support our growing portfolio of AI Factory

and Cloud Services colocation projects. This role is ideal for early-career construction professionals or

technically experienced candidates looking to expand their construction expertise in a fast-paced,

innovative environment. As a generalist, you'll support the planning, coordination, and execution of critical

infrastructure projects while developing experience across construction, mechanical and electrical systems, and data center deployment.

What You'll Do:

Assist in managing daily activities across active construction sites, including scheduling, site

coordination, documentation, and vendor oversight

Support senior Construction Managers with project tracking, contractor communications, RFI logs, andsubmittal reviews

Monitor construction progress and help identify risks, delays, or quality concerns, escalating to project leadership as needed

Interface with internal stakeholders (engineering, procurement, operations) and external partners (GCs, vendors, consultants)

Participate in project planning and due diligence meetings, supporting coordination across

construction, engineering, facilities, and operations teams

Review and analyze project schedules and support coordination of work across contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholdersParticipate in site walks, inspections, and punch-list generation

Support budgeting and cost tracking efforts, including reviewing invoices and change orders Help maintain accurate records, drawings, closeout documentation, and as-builts

Develop toward independently managing project activities and leading coordination meetings as experience and project knowledge grow

Ensure safety practices and site protocols are followed in accordance with Crusoe's standards Travel domestically and internationally as required to support project deployments.

What You Bring:

2-5 years of relevant experience in commercial construction, engineering, critical facilities, facilities operations, or a related technical environment

A solid foundation in commercial construction with some technical exposure, OR strong technical experience with exposure to construction/project delivery

Familiarity with core construction processes including scheduling, procurement, and documentation

Comfortable reading construction drawings and interpreting specifications

Experience working with or alongside general contractors, trade partners, vendors, or technical service providers

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

Proficiency with tools like Procore, Bluebeam, or similar construction management platforms

Strong communication skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset

Nice to Have:

Experience in data center, industrial, or mission-critical infrastructure environments

Experience with mechanical and/or electrical systems, whether gained through construction,

engineering, facilities operations, or another technical environment

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or related field, or

equivalent relevant technical/construction experience

Ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a valid passport for international project travel

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $110,000- 135,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About This Role

Crusoe is seeking an experienced and proactive HSE Manager, Data Center Construction, to join our expanding team. This new role, based in our Dallas office, will be an integral member of the Global Safety Pillar, reporting directly to the Senior Director of Global Safety, supporting deployments, data center operations, and R&D projects. You will be crucial in establishing and continuously improving HSE performance, processes, and culture throughout our physical infrastructure operations. The ideal candidate will possess a foundational understanding of safety programs combined with exceptional communications and collaboration skills to drive safety initiatives. This is a full-time position.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • On-Site Safety Leadership: Provide dedicated safety oversight for active deployments and operational data centers, serving as the primary safety point of contact for internal teams and external contractors

  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Assess risks to workers, making recommendations and developing action plans to reduce risk as appropriate.

  • HSE Program Development: Develop and implement various HSE processes, including Right to Know policies and Hazard Communication programs to support a safe and compliant work environment.

  • Compliance and Reporting: Monitor compliance with all federal and state regulations, policies, and procedures. You will also monitor and report on HSE objectives and metrics, ensuring that HSE is an integral part of Management discussions, objectives, and priorities.

  • Incident Management: Facilitate thorough incident investigations and lead root cause analysis efforts following any failures, incidents, or accidents. You will actively monitor and follow up on the status of corrective actions, reports, and audits.

  • Training and Culture: Develop and maintain a high level of HSE awareness and culture through communications, training, and promoting active involvement in HSE programs. You will coordinate and actively participate in the HSE training of personnel.

  • Stakeholder/Regulatory Liaison: Liaise effectively with local contractors, clients, local agencies and air quality boards regarding HSE issues, ensuring open and clear communication.

  • Documentation Management: Ensure that the relevant HSE documentation such as MSDS/SDS folders are meticulously maintained, up to date and readily available at the worksites.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Experience & Education: A minimum of 7+ years of relevant HSE experience is required. While a university degree is preferred, equivalent experience will be considered.

  • Technical Knowledge: Proven technical knowledge of various HSE rules and regulations at both the Federal and State levels. Direct experience with the implementation of HSE rules, regulations, policies, and procedures is a must.

  • Experience with electrical safety standards (e.g., NFPA70E/OSHA30

  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration and reporting.

  • Computer Skills: Excellent computer skills for documentation, reporting, and utilizing HSE management systems.

  • Legal Work Status: Candidates must be able to legally work and reside in the US without requiring sponsorship.

  • Travel Requirements: 50% Travel Required

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting HSE programs within a data center, cloud infrastructure, or R&D environment.

  • Professional certifications such as CSP, ASP, or OHST.

  • Familiarity with environmental regulations impacting data center operations.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of $129,000 - $157,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. (#INDCORP)

title: Senior System Tests & Diagnostics Engineer
description:
About us
Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.
It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 
Responsibilities and Duties
We are seeking a highly skilled System Tests & Diagnostics Engineer to develop, extend, and integrate specialized silicon validation and diagnostics tools for next-generation AI SoCs.
Unlike traditional validation roles focused on executing test plans, this position is responsible for developing the diagnostic software and stress tools that expose hardware failures, characterize silicon behavior, and improve platform observability throughout bring-up and validation.
You will work closely with Arm engineers to understand and extend existing diagnostics technologies while developing Graphcore-specific capabilities for future AI hardware.Role Summary
You will work with existing Arm-developed diagnostics technologies and extend them to support Graphcore's next-generation AI silicon.
You will be responsible for developing system-level diagnostics and stress tools that integrate with an existing framework to detect data integrity, computational correctness, performance, and reliability issues across CPUs, AI accelerators, memory, storage, PCIe, firmware, BMC, and other platform components. Examples include silent data corruption (SDC) tests, power transient stress tools, and platform diagnostics, with opportunities to develop new diagnostics as future hardware capabilities evolve.
This role requires close collaboration with hardware architects, firmware engineers, validation engineers, and diagnostics teams to understand new hardware capabilities and translate them into reusable diagnostic software.
Responsibilities

Learn and extend existing Arm diagnostics tools to support Graphcore’s AI platform.
Develop specialized diagnostics and stress-testing software for CPU, memory, interconnect, PCIe, and other system components.
Build reusable validation utilities that integrate into the existing validation framework.
Develop tools that expose intermittent hardware failures including silent data corruption, timing-related issues, and hardware instability.
Design configurable diagnostic applications supporting multiple silicon revisions, platforms, and execution environments.
Develop automation for executing diagnostics across server and rack-scale validation environments.
Design configuration-driven diagnostics supporting scalable parameterization and workload variation.
Collaborate with hardware architects to understand new hardware capabilities and identify missing diagnostics.
Work closely with firmware and validation teams to improve hardware observability.
Debug low-level hardware, firmware, operating system, and driver interactions.
Analyze diagnostic output and improve fault isolation methodologies.
Develop software that enables engineers to reproduce and investigate difficult hardware failures.
Contribute reusable libraries and utilities that improve engineering productivity across multiple validation teams.

Candidate Profile
Essential

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
6+ years of experience developing hardware diagnostics, system validation software, firmware validation tools, or low-level systems software.
Strong software development skills in Python and C/C++.
Strong Linux systems experience.
Strong understanding of modern server platform architecture, including how CPU, memory, PCIe, storage, networking, firmware, operating system, and device drivers interact within a complete system.
Experience debugging hardware/software interactions across multiple layers of the platform.
Experience developing diagnostics, stress testing, or hardware validation software.
Experience with server platforms, embedded systems, or SoC validation.
Strong analytical and debugging skills.
Experience collaborating across hardware, firmware, software, and validation teams.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Desirable:

Preferred Qualifications

Arm-based server platforms
AI accelerators or high-performance computing systems
Silent Data Corruption (SDC) testing
Hardware stress testing
Power transient analysis
Hardware fault injection methodologies
Firmware validation
Silicon bring-up
Performance characterization
Hardware telemetry and observability
BMC firmware or server management
RAS (Reliability, Availability, Serviceability) technologies
Validate across subsystems:

CPU scaling and cache behavior
Memory (DDR/HBM) bandwidth, latency, and NUMA effects
Interconnect contention under multi-core load
PCIe/I-O throughput, latency, and multi-device scenarios
High-speed I/O validation

What Success Looks Like
Successful candidates will:

Extend existing diagnostics technologies to support new Graphcore hardware.
Develop new diagnostics tools for emerging hardware capabilities.
Build reusable software components that integrate seamlessly with the existing validation framework.
Improve hardware observability and root-cause isolation.
Detect and characterize intermittent hardware failures that traditional validation techniques cannot expose.
Deliver configurable diagnostics that scale across multiple platforms and silicon revisions.
Work effectively across hardware, firmware, validation, and diagnostics teams to continuously improve platform quality.

Why Join Graphcore?
This role provides a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of hardware architecture, diagnostics, and software engineering while helping define how next-generation AI systems are validated.
Rather than maintaining an existing validation framework, you will develop the specialized diagnostics and stress tools that make that framework valuable. Your work will directly influence hardware quality, silicon bring-up, and long-term platform reliability for future AI infrastructure.
USA BenefitsIn addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

title: Staff PCB Layout Engineer
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented PCB Layout Engineer to maintain electronic component libraries and develop printed circuit board layouts. This role works closely with electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, procurement, and NPI to ensure component data and PCB designs are accurate, consistent, and ready for production.
This position is in Austin, Texas.
 
Key Responsibilities

Create, verify, and maintain schematic symbols, PCB footprints, and associated 3D models.
Validate component pin assignments, dimensions, land patterns, and library attributes against manufacturer documentation.
Maintain library naming conventions, revision control, and component approval processes.
Develop PCB layouts from approved schematics, including component placement, routing, stackup coordination, and design rule setup.
Collaborate with engineers to address electrical, mechanical, thermal, and manufacturing requirements.
Run design rule checks, resolve layout issues, and participate in design reviews.
Prepare fabrication and assembly deliverables, including Gerber or ODB++ files, drill files, drawings, and pick-and-place data.
Coordinate with PCB fabricators and assembly suppliers to resolve manufacturing questions.
Support engineering changes and maintain accurate release documentation.
Work with procurement and engineering to identify obsolete components and evaluate suitable alternatives.

Required Qualifications

Experience with setting up PCB design and electronic component library management.
Proficiency in Cadence Allegro/OrCAD.
Ability to interpret schematics, component datasheets, and mechanical drawings.
Working knowledge of PCB fabrication, assembly processes, and design for manufacturability.
Familiarity with relevant IPC standards for PCB design and component land patterns.
Strong attention to detail, documentation skills, and ability to manage competing priorities.

Experience with multilayer, high-density, mixed-signal, and high-speed PCB designs.
Familiarity with signal integrity, power integrity, grounding, and EMI/EMC considerations.
College degree, technical training, or equivalent practical experience in PCB layout

 
 
USA BenefitsIn addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. title: Energy Analytics Analyst
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW 
Hanwha Energy USA, headquartered in Houston, Texas, is part of the Hanwha Group—a FORTUNE Global 300 company and one of South Korea’s most respected business enterprises. With over a decade of experience delivering high-quality, utility-scale energy projects across North America, Hanwha Energy USA has evolved into a comprehensive energy solutions provider. Our portfolio now spans utility-scale renewables, natural gas generation, retail electricity, and strategic partnerships that power America’s growing data center industry.
Our expertise covers the entire energy value chain—from project development and engineering to construction, operations, and maintenance. By integrating advanced technologies, proven processes, and strong partnerships, we deliver reliable, customized solutions that meet the dynamic needs of local energy markets.
Hanwha Energy USA is actively advancing strategic initiatives in natural gas generation and data center development, including hyperscaler solutions on both sides of the meter. We are proud to serve as the parent company of:

Hanwha Renewables – specializing in utility-scale solar and battery energy storage systems (BESS)
Chariot Energy – providing retail electricity services for residential, commercial, and industrial customers in deregulated markets

 
POSITION OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced Energy Analytics Analyst who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and driven to deliver business results. The ideal candidate will have 1-3 years of experience in deregulated retail electricity and/or wholesale power markets, with a strong understanding of ERCOT and PJM market fundamentals, load forecasting, price formation, risk management, and supply portfolio optimization.
As part of Hanwha Energy USA's Energy Analytics team, this role will support critical commercial, trading, risk management, and operational decision-making through data-driven analysis and forecasting. The successful candidate will develop and maintain analytical models, extract actionable insights from large datasets, and partner closely with stakeholders across trading, origination, risk, supply management, and retail businesses.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities in SQL, Python, data visualization, and modern AI/LLM technologies with a practical understanding of energy markets. This individual should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from concept through implementation, driving results with minimal supervision, and rolling up their sleeves to solve business problems regardless of scope or complexity.
Reporting to the Sr. Director of Energy Analytics, this role requires a self-motivated professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates effectively with both technical and business audiences, and consistently demonstrates accountability, initiative, and attention to detail.
This role will be located in Houston Texas, and the ideal candidate will be within commutable distance to the Houston office location. This is an onsite required role.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES

As part of Hanwha Energy USA’s Analytics team, this position will play a pivotal role in developing innovative solutions for our wholesale analytical needs.
Develop and enhance analytical solutions supporting wholesale power, retail energy, risk management, and supply optimization activities.
Build, maintain, and improve load, price growth margin forecasting and market intelligence models for ERCOT and PJM markets.
Support trading, risk, supply management and marketing teams through scenario analysis, position evaluation, exposure reporting, pricing support and market research.
Design and develop scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytics tools using SQL and Python.
Leverage Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and machine learning techniques to improve business efficiency, automate workflows, and enhance forecasting capabilities.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that enable stakeholders to make informed business decisions.
Partner with technology, commercial, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Lead analytics projects from requirements gathering through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
Communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve existing processes, data quality, forecasting methodologies, and business workflows.
Perform ad hoc analysis and assist with critical business needs as required.

 
REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

Analytical - Proven problem-solving capability with strong analytical skills including statistical analysis.
Stakeholder Engagement – Understands the importance of seeking out relationships and working with others toward a shared goal.
Effective Communication - Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Agility - Demonstrate willingness to modify position as needed to meet the needs of the business

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s Degree Required in Finance, Economics or any other quantitative hard science.
1-3 years of energy industry experience applying modelling techniques in successful business applications.
Strong interpersonal skills with capability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
Strong understanding of ERCOT market structure and fundamentals; familiarity with PJM markets preferred.
Strong interpersonal and presentation skills coupled with deep analytical capabilities.
Hands-on experience supporting retail power and/or wholesale power businesses through load forecasting, price forecasting, market analytics, risk management, and supply portfolio optimization initiatives.
Strong verbal and writing skills
Ability to multitask and work under multiple deadlines
Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects from inception through successful implementation.
Self-motivated and ability to work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and independent work ethic is essential.
Deadline-oriented with an ability to prioritize tasks.
Strong decision-making skills in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Strong knowledge in programming (Python, SQL), visualization tools (Plotly, PowerBI)
Self-starter with a strong work ethic, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to take ownership beyond defined responsibilities when necessary.
Eligible to work in the USA for any employer without sponsorship.

 
PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS

Strong technical knowledge on time series modelling (GBM, LSTM) and deep learning/generative AI (CNN, VAE, GAN)
Thorough understanding of the analytical drivers of the energy industry including weather, consumption patterns, wholesale and retail prices, particularly for ERCOT and PJM markets
Experience with ETRM systems, Dayzer, Yes Energy, Hitachi/Endur, Amperon, or similar energy market platforms.
Working knowledge of Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI-assisted development tools, and practical business applications of AI.
Experience developing AI-enabled analytics solutions, agents, copilots, or workflow automation tools.
Knowledge of renewable generation, battery storage, natural gas markets, and power asset optimization.
An advanced degree, preferably Ph.D, in Engineering, Math, Physics or in a related field of study

 
COMPENSATION: $115,000 -$140,000 salary
 
Attention external recruitment firms, we will not accept any unsolicited resumes at this time. Please do not contact any internal member of our company to discuss the position or to solicit candidates.
Hanwha Energy USA provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics.

title: Apprentice Electrician
description:

Company: Loenbro, LLC Business Unit/ Loenbro - South Reports to: General Superintendent  Employment Type: Full-Time FLSA Classification: N-Non-Exempt 
About Loenbro 
Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication, and our vertical market focus spans all industries. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex, so that our clients gain clarity and control in construction and maintenance. We do this by taking full ownership on every interaction, delivering multi-scope project excellence, and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners as we enhance and maintain your critical infrastructure. We have a national presence but a local approach—so that every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care. Through their relationship with us and the One Loenbro model, our customers are able to simplify, control, and succeed in the everyday. 
At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.  
Job Summary 
 
Loenbro is hiring a  Apprentice Electrician, under the direction of Journeyman Electricians, is responsible for the installation, start-up, troubleshooting, commissioning and servicing of industrial / commercial electrical equipment and systems. This position will be responsible for following the directions of the Journeyman Electrician to complete electrical maintenance and repair work.  
 
Essential Job Responsibilities  
 

Observe, learn, and understand a wide range of skills and processes under the instruction of a skilled electrician. 

Demonstrate these skills and processes as on-the-job training progresses by working independently or with others to complete assigned tasks. 

Learn and understand the importance of safety within the workspace and across projects 

Learn about the various tools and materials required for electricians to complete tasks and projects. 

Maintain good housekeeping and organization in the work area. 

Properly utilize the required tools and equipment for each specific task. 

 
Required:  

Have between 2-4 years (4000-7500 OJT hours) of electrical work experience 

Strong understanding of the importance of quality work 

Detail-oriented with strong communication skills 

Ability to communicate effectively with others to promote efficiency 

 
Physical Demands and Work Environment 
The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 
Work Environment: 

Outdoor construction setting with exposure to noise, dust, chemicals, extreme weather, uneven terrain, and other environmental factors. 

Frequent visits to outdoor construction sites with exposure to weather extremes. 

If driving is required, valid driver license and proof of insurability is required. All drivers are subject to a DMV background records search. 

Sit, stoop, crawl, and kneel 

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies. 
 
Benefits 
Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team: 

Medical, dental, and vision insurance 

401(k) retirement plan with company match 

Paid time off (PTO) 

Life and disability insurance 

Professional development and training opportunities 

Employee assistance program (EAP) 

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked. 
 
Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by: 

Living with Integrity 

Exceeding Expectations 

Acting with Urgency 

Delivering Excellence 

 
…we want to hear from you. 
 
Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Construction Supervisor
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.CONSTRUCTION SUPERVISOR
As a critical member of the Starbase Infrastructure team, you will supervise and lead a group of laborers and contractors to enable the build and activation of infrastructure for a variety of projects.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Oversee the day-to-day site supervision of a fast-paced, high impact construction project including the responsibilities below:

Supervise a team dedicated to construction site logistics/operations, including work schedules, project progress, and resource allocation
Plan, implement, and enforce construction site logistics to enable broader project goals and schedule
Manage SpaceX construction assets (trailers, portas, rental equipment, etc.)
Implement and enforce SpaceX safety policies. Drive the safety culture on the jobsite through contractor and internal partners
Daily field coordination and conflict resolution for contractors and internal partners
Manage site logistics, including daily deliveries, offloading, inventory, storage, and staging of SpaceX purchased materials
Responsible for jobsite cleanliness
Create, enforce, and iterate on schedules for workers and subcontractors in conjunction with engineering and project management team
Maintain a daily log for the job site’s operations, reporting to management as necessary

Oversee the procurement and execution of specific construction projects as delegated by the engineering & project management team

Provide budgetary costs based upon the preliminary scope of the project
Gather proposals from contractors; assign contracts upon receipt of all proposals
Develop the final cost and schedule for the sub-project, and implement controls as needed to manage cost, schedule and scope
Coordinate project implementation and track project status
Coordinate with end user and facilities team for building operations and maintenance
Supervise night shift contractors as project work requires

Make changes in the operation as necessary to best meet construction deadlines, triage issues to engineering & project management team as necessary to ensure schedule and quality are adequate

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

High school diploma or equivalency certificate
2+ years of professional experience in engineering, construction management, architecture or facilities management

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Field experience in a technical field or in supervising a multi-discipline team of contractors/laborers
Previous experience with project management and scheduling software
Understanding of multiple disciplines such as civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, piping, geotechnical, and surveying
Experience with project management of construction projects including estimating, cost control, schedule, and contractor management
Experience reading, reviewing, and approving shop and fabrication drawings
Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while maintaining a high sense of urgency in a high-paced, challenging work environment
Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Ability to work at elevated heights (200+ feet)
Physical effort with lifting and carrying materials or equipment (up to 25 lbs.)
Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain
Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise
Must be available to work extended hours and weekends when needed based on site operational needs; flexibility required
Valid driver’s license
Travel may be required based on specific project tasks
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Warehouse Associate
description:
Texas AirSystems has been shaping the HVAC landscape in Texas for over four decades. With 500+ team members and seven offices statewide, we partner with over 60 leading manufacturers to deliver custom, high-performance solutions that stand the test of time.
Here, your work matters. You’ll be part of a team that values collaboration, rewards curiosity, and gives you the tools to keep growing. Whether you’re just getting started or looking for your next big challenge, this is a place where you can thrive and make a real impact.Parts Warehouse Coordinator
Reports to: Parts Store ManagerFLSA Status: Non-Exempt
The Opportunity
Texas AirSystems is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Parts Warehouse Coordinator.
This role goes beyond traditional warehouse duties. The position is responsible for accurately managing shipping and receiving, inventory, and customer orders while providing excellent service to internal and external customers.
The ideal candidate takes ownership of their work, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and understands that accuracy and attention to detail directly impact our customers and our business. We are looking for someone who wants to learn, grow, and build a long-term career with Texas AirSystems.
Responsibilities

Manage shipping, receiving, stocking, and inventory activities.
Accurately pull, verify, and stage orders for customer will-call, delivery, and shipment.
Maintain inventory accuracy through proper documentation and system transactions.
Load and unload customer orders and incoming deliveries.
Provide professional and friendly service to internal and external customers.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe warehouse and showroom.
Use company computer systems to process orders and inventory transactions.
Communicate inventory, order, and shipment issues to appropriate team members.
Take ownership of responsibilities and follow tasks through completion.
Support coworkers and assist wherever needed to meet customer and business needs.
Operate forklifts and other material-handling equipment safely.
Perform other duties as assigned and work overtime/weekends when required.

The Required Profile

High School Diploma or equivalent.
Warehouse, shipping/receiving, inventory, or related experience preferred.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Solid computer skills and ability to learn inventory and order-processing systems.
Strong communication, organization, and customer service skills.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Dependable, accountable, and willing to take ownership.
Team-oriented with a willingness to learn and take on additional responsibilities.
Ability to operate a forklift and maintain certification.

What We’re Looking For
We want team members who take pride in their work, do the right thing, provide exceptional customer service, and support the people around them.
Most importantly, we are looking for individuals with long-term potential. Texas AirSystems wants to invest in employees who are eager to develop their skills, take on greater responsibilities, and grow into future opportunities within the company.
Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status.  Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship.
Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location.

title: Automation Construction Manager, NA
description:
About Vantage Data Centers


Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Construction Department

The Construction team is responsible for the entire process flow of delivering the physical data centers from shovel ready state through commissioning, working with Sales, Operations, and management along the way. Construction implements and executes upon the work product developed by the Development & Engineering (D&E) team. The team also manages Vantage’s build partners to success through technical feedback and review, and actively participating in review of schedule, safety and budget. Many times, a role like this at other companies is purely oversight. One thing that distinguishes Vantage is that our construction teams are given the responsibility and authority to directly drive the process. When compared to external resources, our internal team can ensure the key stakeholders are engaged in the decision-making process to align long-term operational sustainability with value engineering and cost metrics to deliver products aligned with corporate goals. This approach empowers each member of the team to drive high- impact decisions and even more impactful results.

Position Overview

This role will be based on site at our Shackelford County, TX location. 

Vantage is seeking an experienced Automation Construction Manager to lead the planning, installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of automation and controls systems across mission critical data center projects.

This role will oversee the partners responsible of the construction and deployment of building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, HVAC controls, control panels, fan systems, valve controls, alarm monitoring systems, and environmental conditioning systems supporting data center operations. The Automation Construction Manager will coordinate with mechanical, electrical, controls, and commissioning teams to ensure automation infrastructure is installed, integrated and commissioned in accordance with project requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in industrial and facility automation with proven construction project management experience, including scheduling, contractor management, budgeting, risk mitigation, and stakeholder coordination.

Essential Job Functions

Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and execution for automation and controls-related construction activities.

Lead installation and integration of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), SCADA platforms, PLC-based controls, and facility monitoring systems.

Coordinate automation requirements throughout design, procurement, construction, startup, commissioning, and turnover phases.

Oversee installation and functional testing of:

HVAC control systems

Variable frequency drives (VFDs)

Fan wall control systems

Chilled water and condenser water valve controls

Temperature and humidity monitoring systems

Alarm and notification systems

Environmental conditioning controls

High-temperature and low-flow operating sequences

Partner with Engineering, Operations, Commissioning, and Construction teams to ensure controls systems support facility reliability and operational requirements.

Drive automation system readiness for integrated systems testing (IST) and commissioning activities.

Lead general contractor and its associated controls contractors, automation vendors, and system integrators throughout project delivery along with internal Automation support stakeholder.

Review and validate automation sequences of operation, points lists, network architecture, and control drawings.

Develop and manage project schedules, critical path activities, and commissioning milestones.

Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to maintain schedule and operational objectives.

Duties

Coordinate automation and controls activities with MEP, CSA, commissioning, and operations teams.

Review automation design packages, control schematics, panel layouts, SCADA architecture, and network diagrams.

Manage construction and installation of control panels, field devices, instrumentation, sensors, actuators, and communication networks.

Oversee startup and commissioning of:

Air handling units (AHUs)

CRAHs and CRACs

Cooling towers

Chiller plants

Pump systems

Environmental control systems

Electrical LV systems

Electrical MV Systems

Whitespace distribution equipment

Monitor progress against project schedules and coordinate resolution of field conflicts.

Ensure controls systems comply with project specifications, design standards, operational requirements, and applicable codes.

Support integrated systems testing and troubleshooting of automation-related issues.

Review contractor invoices and validate field progress.

Manage vendor performance and coordinate corrective actions when required.

Maintain project reporting including forecasting, budgeting, risk logs, and schedule updates.

Develop lessons learned, value engineering and process improvements focused on controls and automation implementation.

Support operational turnover activities including documentation reviews, training coordination, and acceptance testing.

Additional responsibilities assigned bmy manager.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Industrial Automation, Controls Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

7+ years of experience managing automation, controls, industrial systems, HVAC controls, or mission critical construction projects.

Experience with Building Automation Systems (BAS), Building Management Systems (BMS), and SCADA platforms required.

Experience with automation control strategies supporting HVAC, cooling plants, environmental conditioning systems, and critical infrastructure.

Working knowledge of:

SCADA architecture

PLC systems

Industrial controls

HVAC controls

BACnet, Modbus, and industrial communication protocols

Alarm monitoring systems

Control panel fabrication and installation

Instrumentation and field devices

Experience managing controls contractors, system integrators, commissioning providers, and equipment vendors.

Strong understanding of commissioning processes, sequence of operations testing, and integrated systems testing.

Experience with mission critical facilities, data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, semiconductor plants, manufacturing facilities, power generation facilities, or industrial processing environments preferred.

Demonstrated project management expertise including scheduling, resource planning, budgeting, forecasting, risk mitigation, and stakeholder management.

Proficiency with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar scheduling tools preferred.

Preferred Background

Data Center construction and commissioning experience.

Industrial automation, process controls, or facility controls background.

Hands-on experience with HVAC optimization, chilled water systems, airflow management, valve sequencing, and environmental monitoring systems.

Experience supporting large-scale mission critical facilities where system uptime, reliability, and operational resilience are key business requirements.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

#LI-Onsite #LI-CM2

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

 

Position Overview

This position will be on site in our Shackelford Texas location. 

The Senior Manager, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) will support the development, implementation, and execution of the Environmental Health, and Safety program for Project Frontier, a large-scale AI Data Center development in Abilene, Texas. Acting as the Owner/Developer's EHS representative, this role will provide day-to-day leadership and oversight for all white space construction activities, including data halls, MEP systems, OFCI equipment installation, testing, and commissioning. 

The Senior Manager will partner closely with the EHS Director, General Contractor (GC), OFCI vendors, commissioning teams, and specialty trade partners to ensure consistent EHS expectations, compliance, and accountability while fostering a proactive, incident-free safety culture. The role requires autonomy and oversight of processes including, but not limited to:

Electrical Safety (Energized Electrical Work, Arc Flash)

Control of Hazardous Energy (Lockout/Tagout)

Occupational Noise Exposure & Control

Heat Stress & Illness Prevention

Exposure Assessment (Industrial Hygiene)

Emergency Response Planning

Working at Heights

Confined Space Entry

Heavy Material Handling

Powered Industrial Trucks (Forklifts)

Construction-Related Risks (Cranes/Rigging, Trenching/Shoring, Mobile Elevated Work Platforms (MEWPs), etc.)

Fire/Life Safety

Hazardous Substances Handling

Waste Management

Ergonomics

Spill Prevention Control and Countermeasures (SPCC)

Risk Assessment and Mitigation methodology

Incident management and Investigations

Essential Job Functions

Provide strategic leadership and ensure adherence to health and safety standards, policies, and practices including but not limited to; safety management systems, training, risk assessments, industrial hygiene, and regulatory compliance.

Lead and oversee health and safety audits across operational data centers and construction sites to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.

Ensure enterprise-wide compliance with safety programs that exceed regulatory requirements.

Develop and review comprehensive health and safety plans for emergencies, business continuity, and unique operational events.

Oversee safety record keeping and ensure data integrity across all sites.

Analyze safety data trends and present findings to executive leadership to inform strategic decisions.

Serve as a key advisor to the VDC compliance team, providing expert interpretations and guidance.

Identify systemic risks and lead cross-functional teams to implement sustainable controls.

Engage with customers and stakeholders to deliver high-level health and safety guidance.

Duties

EHS Leadership & Site Oversight

Support implementation of the Project Frontier EHS strategy and objectives for white space construction activities.

Provide daily field leadership and EHS oversight across white space work areas.

Mentor and support project EHS professionals and contractor safety teams.

Promote a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement across all project stakeholders.

White Space Construction & Commissioning

Provide EHS oversight for data hall construction, critical electrical and mechanical systems, controls installation, testing, and commissioning activities.

Monitor high-risk work activities, including energized work, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), work at heights, rigging and lifting operations, confined space entry, hot work, chemical management, and commissioning/start-up activities.

Review work plans, method statements, and commissioning procedures to ensure EHS risks are identified and controlled.

Participate in construction planning and sequencing reviews to support safe work execution.

Compliance & Risk Management

Support compliance with all applicable federal, state, local, and project-specific EHS requirements.

Implement and maintain project EHS procedures, standards, and safe work practices.

Lead and facilitate hazard assessments, risk evaluations, Job Safety Analyses (JSAs), and pre-task planning reviews.

Conduct field audits, inspections, and behavioral observations.

Track, monitor, and verify closure of corrective actions.

Contractor & Vendor Management

Serve as a primary EHS interface between the Owner, General Contractor (GC), OFCI vendors, commissioning teams, and trade partners.

Review contractor EHS documentation, permits, work plans, and risk assessments.

Support onboarding, orientation, and ongoing EHS engagement activities for contractors and vendors.

Ensure alignment of EHS expectations across multiple parallel workstreams.

Monitor contractor performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Participate in incident investigations and root cause analyses.

Assist with development and tracking of corrective and preventive actions.

Track and communicate project EHS performance metrics, trends, and emerging risks.

Prepare reports and presentations for project leadership and key stakeholders.

Minimum 5 years of EHS experience in data center construction, mission-critical facilities, or large-scale industrial construction projects. 

Proven ability to lead beyond compliance, driving cultural change and partnering with stakeholders to implement innovative and effective risk control strategies.

Demonstrated experience supporting EHS programs during white space construction and commissioning activities. 

Strong understanding of contractor management and construction safety requirements. 

Experience working within complex, fast-paced construction environments.
